sentences: This record concerns the algebraic decision problems denoted AnnAtZero and APS in the cited paper.
It asks whether they lie in Arthur–Merlin interactive proof complexity over characteristic-zero fields under the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis.
The surrounding study connects algebraic dependencies with algorithms for approximative computation.
Such a containment would give a substantially different complexity upper-bound perspective than the PSPACE methods named in the source title.
